shortDescription: Wait for a BIG-IP condition before continuing

options.name: delay
options.description: Number of seconds to wait before starting to poll.

options.name: msg
options.description: This overrides the normal error message from a failure to meet the required conditions.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: sleep
options.description: Number of seconds to sleep between checks. Before version 2.3 this was hardcoded to 1 second.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Maximum number of seconds to wait. When used without other conditions, it is equivalent of just sleeping. The default timeout is deliberately set to 2 hours because there is no individual REST API.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of the BIG-IP. Defaults to C(standard), the other choice is C(vcmp). This choice defines which module or service Ansible looks for to establish that the device has recovered, so ensure to specify the correct choice, especially when running this against VCMP.
